title: rhus canadensis var. trilobata
intro: Rhus canadensis var. trilobata, commonly known as skunkbush or wolfberry, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and skin conditions. Skunkbush is rich in bioactive constituents like triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of skunkbush include reducing oxidative stress, modulating immune responses, and providing protection against cancer cell growth.
